newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IAWS invests 4.2mln stg in N.Ireland's Dalgety.
newsitem.headline: IAWS invests 4.2mln stg in N.Ireland's Dalgety.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group IAWS Plc said on Friday that it had invested 4.2 million sterling for a 50 percent share in a joint venture which has acquired the Northern Ireland business of Dalgety Agricutlure Limited.
The Belfast-based business includes the manufacture of feeds, silo operations together with the distribution of fertiliser, seed and agrochemicals, IAWS said in a statement.
The joint venture company will acquire fixed assets of 7.3 million sterling, the statement said.
Pretax profits attributable to the business were 988,000 sterling for the year ended June 20, it said.
